repos.name: mizorewww/laya-mlx
repos.description: Native MLX runtime for Laya typed decision models — 7–14 ms short decisions on M3 Max. No text generation, PyTorch, or cloud API.
repos.one_liner: A native MLX runtime for Laya typed decision models optimized for Apple Silicon.
bullets: Built on Apple's MLX framework for high-performance local inference.
Achieves 7–14 ms latency on M3 Max hardware for decision-making tasks.
Eliminates dependencies on PyTorch, cloud APIs, or heavy text generation stacks.
Ideal for low-latency agentic decision loops in local environments.
repos.img_alt: Laya MLX playing Snake — actual decisions, original speed

repos.name: FailproofAI/failproofai
repos.description: Runtime failure resolution for coding agents. Hooks into Claude Code and Codex. Catches loops, dangerous actions, and secret leaks before they become incidents. Zero latency. Runs locally.
repos.one_liner: A runtime safety and failure resolution layer for coding agents.
bullets: TypeScript-based middleware that hooks into Claude Code and Codex.
Provides real-time monitoring to catch infinite loops, dangerous system calls, and secret leaks.
Operates locally with zero-latency overhead to prevent production incidents.
Essential infrastructure for deploying autonomous agents in sensitive development workflows.

repos.name: context-labs/whip
repos.description: A fast coding-agent harness in Go. Tool-use loop, bubbletea TUI, provider-routable models with live catalog discovery, MCP support, background subagents. One binary, no runtime, built for open-source models.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance Go-based harness for coding agents featuring MCP support.
bullets: Written in Go as a single binary with no complex runtime requirements.
Features a Bubbletea-based TUI for managing agent tool-use loops and subagents.
Includes provider-routable model support and live catalog discovery.
Designed for developers building robust, modular agentic infrastructure.

repos.name: docling-project/docling
repos.description: Get your documents ready for gen AI
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive toolkit for parsing and converting diverse document formats into AI-ready structures.
bullets: Supports high-quality conversion of PDF, DOCX, HTML, and images into Markdown or JSON.
Optimized for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines by preserving document semantics.
Includes advanced table structure recognition and OCR capabilities.
Critical infrastructure for fintech and legal firms processing unstructured financial documents.

repos.name: tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction
repos.description: Claude Code plugin that replaces the compaction summary with Jev decisions: every tool call and result is scored in one fast request, stale ones are dropped or truncated, everything kept stays verbatim.
repos.one_liner: A Claude Code plugin that optimizes context windows using Jev-based typed decision scoring.
bullets: Replaces standard compaction summaries with high-speed, scored decision logs.
Uses typed decision models to prune stale tool calls and results dynamically.
Reduces token consumption while maintaining verbatim context for critical agent actions.
Improves agent reliability and cost-efficiency in long-running coding sessions.
